root_cause.claim: The decoder incorrectly treated secondary metatile ID 0x208 as globally walkable; Granite Cave uses it as a collision-1 obstruction, while map type 4 rolls land encounters on collision-free cave floor.
evidence: two cartridge clone replays rejected the 22,8 -> 23,8 edge
RAM word for 23,8 is metatile 0x208 collision 1
MapHeader mapType is 4 and the corrected hunter selects collision-0 pair 22,8 <-> 21,8
alternatives_falsified: No NPC occupies the edge: authoritative live object list is empty
The failure is not random encounter interruption: battle.active remained false

solution.contract_change: Secondary tileset IDs no longer override collision globally; underground map type 4 uses walkable cave floor as its land-encounter surface.

targeted_checks.name: map decoder and underground surface tests

replay.expected: corrected hunt selects floor pair [(22,8),(21,8)] without targeting blocked 0x208
replay.actual: both runs selected [(22,8),(21,8)] and completed one bounded step without adaptive-path failure

domain_knowledge: Gen III secondary metatile IDs are tileset-local; underground map type 4 encounters occur on ordinary walkable cave floor.
tooling_contracts: Never use a secondary metatile ID alone to override collision across maps.
